name: wallet-as-a-service
description: Single-exchange NestJS user, wallet, sweep, signer, broadcast, activity-listener, and ledger services using Prisma, PostgreSQL and durable queues

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run db:generate && nest build --all && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.dev:signer: npm run db:generate && nest start signer --watch
scripts.dev:wallet: npm run db:generate && nest start wallet --watch
scripts.dev:activity-listener: npm run db:generate && nest start activity-listener --watch
scripts.dev:ledger: npm run db:generate && nest start ledger --watch
scripts.db:generate: prisma generate && prisma generate --config prisma.broadcast.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.ledger.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.activity.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.user.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.sweep.config.ts
scripts.dev:broadcast: npm run db:generate && nest start broadcast --watch
scripts.build:wallet: npm run db:generate && nest build wallet
scripts.build:signer: npm run db:generate && nest build signer
scripts.build:broadcast: npm run db:generate && nest build broadcast
scripts.build:activity-listener: npm run db:generate && nest build activity-listener
scripts.build:ledger: npm run db:generate && nest build ledger
scripts.dev:user: npm run db:generate && nest start user --watch
scripts.build:user: npm run db:generate && nest build user
scripts.dev:sweep: npm run db:generate && nest start sweep --watch
scripts.build:sweep: npm run db:generate && nest build sweep
